slides.hook: One mana. Equip for one, your 1/1 dies, you draw two cards. Repeat.

reasons.text: Every 1/1 token in your deck becomes 'draw two cards' for one mana.
It's colorless. There's no deck that can't run it.
The +1/-1 is the engine, not a drawback. That's the whole card.

slides.watch_out: It kills your own one-toughness creatures. Don't clamp the mana dork you still need.

slides.question: What's the best thing you've ever clamped?
